items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1959-09-25
items.q: Matthews used to be a drummer. Bill Matthews.

ctx.x: And it seems to me he played bass down here with a band that Clarence Williams had in charge.
That was what Matthews did too. Matthews used to be a drummer. Bill Matthews.
How did he rate the drummers?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Matthews, yeah, had him in the band.

ctx.x: And he come along though, he come along because I'll tell ya, who was it?

Some man got up and started singing the blues, a trumpet player, I don't know who you were now, in Bob Lyons band, he played trumpet and he sung the blues and after that where everybody's trumpet player started singing. Who could that been anyhow? Let me see what Bob used to have with him. Boy used to write music, what did he name, not Mad Cat, he used to play with him. You know this boy, he ain't been dead long. He used to play with him. Lewis, what was his name, Lewis? Lewis Dumaine. Lewis Dumaine. He sang the…
Well what did the Dots boys play?

items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: Yeah, this guy played a drum with him. Bill Matthews.

ctx.x: Did he have a good drummer then?
Yeah, this guy played a drum with him. Bill Matthews.
